Stomach Steinway Man

Its wierd that this tune isnt up here, its a regular ‘late night’ tune down out local and i found the ABD details from a simple google.

usulally played as a set:
fairwell to chernobyl. (D min)
stomach steinway man. (D min)
catharsis. (G min)

great fun for anyone not playing a D whistle ;)
